artifactAccepted.closeButton: Homepage and PDP records show focus entered BUTTON.ct-toggle-close and returned to a BUTTON claimed to be the trigger.
artifactAccepted.escapeAndBackdropFocus: Both templates record isSameAsTrigger=true after the stated close actions.

artifactGaps: Backdrop and Escape records contain only focus equality; they do not record an open state or prove the drawer became closed (aria-expanded=false, aria-hidden, is-active, or inert).
No Tab/Shift+Tab sequence proves focus containment or the next Tab position after restoration.
No repeated-cycle trace records inert cleanup, handler duplication, trigger removal fallback, or search-modal regression.
The handoff claims dialog semantics, but the committed artifact contains no role, aria-modal, aria-controls, aria-expanded, or close-label fields.
No actual screen-reader run, transcript, speech log, or named AT/browser combination is supplied; DOM ARIA strings are not the acceptance-required screen-reader check.

syntheticBackdropProbe.note: A DOM click() probe did not close the drawer; this is not treated as a conclusive pointer failure, but it also cannot validate the artifact's backdrop claim.

independentPdpCheck.escapeProbeLimitation: The subsequent sequence did not re-prove an open state before Escape and is excluded from the verdict.

decision: Keep R26-01 PARTIAL/OPEN. Provide full state transitions for each close path, Tab containment/continuation, repeated inert/handler checks, search regression, and one named screen-reader run.
